/legal/cookie-policy.title: Apcosys Cookie Policy
/legal/cookie-policy.html:
Introduction

Apcosys LLC (“we,” “us,” or “our”) uses cookies, web beacons, pixel tags, and other tracking technologies when you visit our website https://apcosys.net/, including any related media forms, channels, mobile websites, or applications (collectively, the “Site”). These technologies help us enhance your experience and personalize the Site’s functionality.

We may update this Cookie Policy at any time. Changes will be reflected by updating the “Last Updated” date. Updates take effect immediately upon posting on the Site, and your continued use of the Site signifies your acceptance of the revised policy. We recommend reviewing this Cookie Policy periodically to stay informed.

Use of Cookies

A cookie is a small data file that assigns you a unique identifier stored on your device. When you interact with the Site, your browser uses this identifier to facilitate your requests.

Cookies enable us to:

  • Track services used.
  • Store registration details.
  • Remember preferences.
  • Maintain login sessions.
  • Streamline purchases.
  • Monitor page visits.

They help us analyze Site usage and improve your experience.

We use the following cookie types to optimize your experience:

  • Strictly Necessary Cookies: Essential for the Site’s core functionality, including security, authentication, and payment processing.
  • Personalization Cookies: Tailor your experience by saving preferences and settings.
  • Analytics Cookies: Provide insights into Site usage to enhance our services.
  • Advertising Cookies: Deliver relevant ads and measure their effectiveness.

Cookies We May Use

Strictly Necessary Cookies

These cookies are vital for security, network management, and accessibility. Disabling them via browser settings may impair Site functionality.

  • Landing Page Cookies: Store preferences for privacy settings, login, or form submissions.
  • CSRF Protection Cookie: Safeguards your data during Site interactions.
  • Google reCAPTCHA Service Cookie: Protects against spam and abuse.
  • Google Storage Cookie: Supports security features like authentication and fraud prevention.
  • Payment Service Provider Cookie: Facilitates secure transactions via our payment provider, Paddle.com.

Personalization Cookies

These cookies recognize returning visitors and support features like language settings.

  • Google Functionality Storage Cookie: Enhances Site functionality, such as language preferences.
  • Google Personalization Storage Cookie: Personalizes content, like video recommendations.

Analytics Cookies

Analytics cookies help us understand Site usage to improve performance, including Google Analytics cookies.

Advertising Cookies

These cookies deliver tailored advertisements and track ad performance, including:

  • Google Storage Cookies for Advertising: Support ad delivery.
  • Google Consent Cookie for Advertising Data: Manages user data sent to Google for ads.
  • Google Consent Cookie for Personalized Advertising: Enables customized ad experiences.

Control of Cookies

You can manage cookie preferences through the Site’s cookie consent settings, except for Strictly Necessary Cookies, which are required for service delivery.

Most browsers accept cookies by default, but you can modify settings to reject or remove cookies. Note that this may impact Site functionality.

For guidance on managing cookies, check your browser or device settings or visit:

  • Apple Safari
  • Google Chrome
  • Mozilla Firefox
  • Opera
  • Android (Chrome)
  • iPhone or iPad (Chrome)
  • iPhone or iPad (Safari)

Other Tracking Technologies

We may use web beacons, pixel tags, or similar technologies to customize the Site and improve your experience.

These tools, embedded in pages or emails, track metrics like page visits or email views, collecting limited data such as cookie numbers, timestamps, and page details.

While you cannot decline web beacons or pixel tags, controlling cookies that interact with them can limit their functionality.

Privacy Policy

For details on how we handle data collected via cookies and tracking technologies, refer to our Privacy Policy on the Site.

This Cookie Policy is part of and incorporated into our Privacy Policy. By using the Site, you agree to both policies.

/legal/data-collection-policy.title: Apcosys Data Collection Policy
/legal/data-collection-policy.html:
What and How Apcosys Collects

The Apcosys app collects only publicly available, externally accessible data using nonintrusive methods. Our algorithms employ standardized, open network protocols to query hosts and retrieve specific attributes. Examples of collected data include:

  • Exposed Ports:
    Networked applications use specific ports for communication, such as TCP ports 80 or 443 for web traffic. Security best practices recommend limiting open ports to only those necessary. Services behind these ports often share public metadata known as “banners.”

  • SSL Certificates:
    These enable encrypted communications and contain public information like public keys, domain names, and details about the certificate’s issuer, ensuring secure connections.

  • Whois Database:
    This includes public information about domains, registrants, and registrars, as required by the Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers (ICANN) for public access via Whois directories.

These data types are nonintrusive, as they are publicly accessible to anyone using standard web tools.

Purpose

Our goal is to assist users in research, marketing, and enhancing cybersecurity. We aim to contribute to a safer, more robust Internet, aligning with principles like those outlined at https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/about/manifesto/. Apcosys supports this vision by providing tools for informed decision-making.

We do not use intrusive techniques, conduct penetration testing, bypass security measures, or access private data without explicit consent and verified ownership. Upon request, we can perform detailed scans of hosts you own using intrusive methods, with results provided exclusively to you.

Legislation

Apcosys complies with applicable laws, including the U.S. Computer Fraud and Abuse Act (CFAA), by collecting only public data without unauthorized access. Our operations are designed to respect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of digital assets.

How to Make Information Private

If Apcosys reveals information about your host that you prefer to keep private, you can restrict access by reconfiguring your software. Use Apcosys to rescan your hosts and verify changes to your security perimeter.

This Data Processing Agreement (“Agreement”) outlines how Apcosys LLC (“we,” “us,” or “our”) processes personal data on behalf of users of our services (“you” or “your”). It ensures compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable data protection laws. By using our services, you agree to this Agreement.

1. Definitions

  • GDPR: The General Data Protection Regulation (EU) 2016/679.
  • Personal Data: Information that can identify an individual, such as names, email addresses, or IP addresses.
  • Processing: Any operation performed on Personal Data, including collection, storage, or sharing.
  • Subprocessor: A third-party provider we engage to process Personal Data.

2. Scope of This Agreement

  • This Agreement applies to all Personal Data you provide while using our services.
  • We process your Personal Data to deliver and enhance our services, as described in our Privacy Policy.
  • We act as the Data Processor for your Personal Data, while you, as the Data Controller, determine the purpose and means of data collection and processing.

3. What Data We Process

We may process the following Personal Data:

  • Names, email addresses, and contact information.
  • IP addresses and metadata generated from your use of our services.
  • Other data you submit through your account or communications with us.

4. How We Protect Your Data

We prioritize your privacy and employ robust measures to safeguard your data, including:

  • Encryption: Data is encrypted during transmission.
  • Access Control: Only authorized personnel can access Personal Data.
  • Monitoring: Continuous assessments to detect and address vulnerabilities.

5. Subprocessors

We engage trusted third-party Subprocessors to support our services, including:

  • Paddle.com: Handles payment processing.
  • Pipedrive: Manages customer relationships.
  • Postmark (ActiveCampaign): Facilitates email delivery.

A current list of Subprocessors is available at Subprocessors List.

6. Data Transfers

  • Personal Data may be transferred outside the European Economic Area (EEA) when necessary, with safeguards like Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) to comply with GDPR.
  • For users in other regions, we adhere to local data protection laws to ensure security.

7. Your Rights

Under GDPR and other privacy laws, you have the following rights:

  • Access: Obtain a copy of your Personal Data.
  • Correction: Rectify inaccurate data.
  • Erasure: Request deletion of your data.
  • Restriction: Limit the use of your data.
  • Portability: Transfer your data to another provider.

To exercise these rights, contact info@apcosys.net.

8. Data Breaches

In the event of a data breach affecting your Personal Data, we will notify you promptly, detailing:

  • The nature of the breach.
  • Its potential impact.
  • Mitigation measures taken.

9. Data Retention

We retain Personal Data only as long as necessary to:

  • Provide our services.
  • Comply with legal obligations.

Data no longer needed is securely deleted.

10. Changes to This Agreement

We may revise this Agreement to reflect updates to our services or legal requirements. Changes will be posted here with the effective date clearly indicated.

11. Contact Us

For questions about this Agreement or our data processing practices, please contact us.

Acceptance of Terms

By using our services, you accept the terms of this Data Processing Agreement. If you do not agree, please stop using our services.

Derivative Data

Data automatically collected by our servers, such as your IP address, browser type, operating system, access times, and pages viewed before and after accessing the Site.

Mobile Device Data

Device details, such as mobile device ID, model, or manufacturer, if you access the Site from a mobile device.

Third-Party Data

Information obtained from third parties, such as marketing leads or personal data, with your consent.

Data From Contests, Giveaways, and Surveys

Information you provide when participating in contests, giveaways, or surveys.

Accurate information enables us to deliver a seamless, efficient, and personalized experience. We may use your information to:

  • Manage contests, promotions, or sweepstakes.
  • Compile anonymous statistical data for internal or third-party analysis.
  • Create and maintain your account.
  • Deliver targeted ads, newsletters, or promotional updates.
  • Communicate about your account or orders.
  • Process purchases, payments, and refunds.
  • Build a personalized profile to enhance future Site visits.
  • Optimize Site performance and functionality.
  • Analyze usage trends to improve user experience.
  • Notify you of Site updates or new offerings.
  • Prevent fraud, monitor for theft, or protect against illegal activity.
  • Address disputes, troubleshoot issues, or respond to service requests.
  • Send newsletters or solicit Site support.

Disclosure of Your Information

We may share your information in the following cases:

By Law or to Protect Rights

We may disclose your information if required by law, to address policy violations, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of others, including sharing with entities for fraud prevention or credit risk reduction.

Third-Party Service Providers

We may share your information with third parties providing services like payment processing, data analysis, email delivery, hosting, customer support, or marketing.

Marketing Communications

With your consent, we may share your information with third parties for marketing purposes, as permitted by law. You may withdraw consent at any time.

Affiliates

We may share your information with affiliates, who are required to adhere to this Privacy Policy. Affiliates include our parent company, subsidiaries, or entities under common control.

Other Third Parties

We may share your information with third parties, such as investors, for general business analysis.

Sale or Bankruptcy

In the event of a merger, asset sale, or bankruptcy, your information may be transferred to a successor entity, which may not honor commitments made in this policy.

We are not responsible for third parties’ actions regarding your data. To stop receiving third-party communications, contact them directly.

Tracking Technologies

Cookies and Web Beacons

We use cookies, web beacons, and other tracking technologies to enhance and personalize your Site experience. See our Cookie Policy for details, which is incorporated into this Privacy Policy. Using the Site signifies agreement to the Cookie Policy.

Internet-Based Advertising

We may use third-party software for email marketing or interactive campaigns, which may employ cookies or similar technologies to optimize your experience. You can opt out of interest-based ads via the Digital Advertising Alliance Opt-Out Tool.

Website Analytics

We partner with third-party vendors, such as Google Analytics, to track Site usage and content popularity using first- and third-party cookies. By accessing the Site, you consent to this data collection. Review the vendors’ privacy policies for details or opt out via their settings or the Digital Advertising Alliance Opt-Out Tool. Changing devices or browsers may affect opt-out settings.

Third-Party Websites

The Site may link to third-party websites, ads, or services not affiliated with us. Information you provide to these parties is not covered by this Privacy Policy, and we cannot guarantee its safety. Review their privacy policies before sharing data. We are not responsible for third-party content or practices.

Security of Your Information

We implement administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your personal information. However, no security measures are infallible, and data transmission risks interception or misuse. We cannot guarantee absolute security for information you provide.

Policy for Children

We do not knowingly collect data from or market to children under 13. If we learn we have collected such data, please contact us, and we will take appropriate action.

Controls for Do-Not-Track Features

Most browsers and mobile devices offer a Do-Not-Track (DNT) feature to signal your preference against online tracking. As no universal DNT standard exists, we do not currently respond to DNT signals. If a standard is adopted, we will update this policy accordingly.

Options Regarding Your Information

You can review, update, or terminate your account by:

  • Accessing your account settings to modify your information.
  • Contacting us using the information below.

Upon account termination, we will deactivate or delete your account and data from active databases, though some information may be retained for fraud prevention, troubleshooting, investigations, or legal compliance.

Emails and Communications

To stop receiving our communications, you can:

  • Update preferences during account registration or in account settings.
  • Contact us using the information below.

For third-party communications, contact the third party directly.

California Privacy Rights

Under California’s “Shine The Light” law (Civil Code Section 1798.83), California residents may request, once per year, free information about personal data shared with third parties for direct marketing in the prior calendar year. Submit requests using the contact information below.

California residents under 18 with registered accounts may request removal of publicly posted data. Contact us with your account email and a statement of California residency. We will ensure the data is not publicly displayed, though complete removal from our systems is not guaranteed.

Contact Us

For questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us info@apcosys.net.
